title: Star of the Week: Trinidad Chambliss
parts:
⭐ STAR OF THE WEEK

Trinidad Chambliss | QB | Ole Miss | SR

19 of 20, 367 yds and 5 TD vs Wofford, his most pass yds of 2026. 47.0 Fantrax pts, the best Week 12 line from a top-50 prospect in the Alpha Draft Signal.

His card 👇

🧬 Who he is

A 6'1", 200-lb QB in his fourth year out of HS; his card tags him a rhythm/timing passer. In 2025: 3,934 pass yds, 22 TD and 3 INT in 14 games (8.8 YPA).

2026, 10 games before Week 12: 248.6 pass yds and 1.9 TD per game, on 96% of Ole Miss' attempts.

🧠 Why he's a star

He protects the ball: his card grades him 73 on ball security and 64 on big-time throws.

#43 QB in the Alpha Draft Signal (preseason: #29).

Production comps on his card: Donovan Smith (Houston '23) and Brayden Schager (Hawai'i '24).

📅 Next: Mississippi State at Ole Miss, Fri Nov 27, 12 PM ET (the Egg Bowl).

Eligible for the 2027 NFL Draft.

19 of 20 against an FCS defense. What does he do in the Egg Bowl? 👇
